units.source_text: 我一直称呼遗孀为‘夫人’，下面也称她‘夫人’吧。

en.t: I have always called the widow Madam, so I will call her Madam below as well.

units.source_text: 她说我是个安静而实在的人，还夸我很爱看书。

en.t: She said I was a quiet and sincere person, and also praised me for loving books.

units.source_text: 然而，对于我那不安的眼神和四处窥视的样子，她却从来没有说过什么。

en.t: Yet she never said anything about my uneasy eyes or the way I kept looking around.

units.source_text: 不知是没有发觉，还是有所顾忌，反正看样子完全没有在意。

en.t: Whether she had not noticed or was holding back, at any rate she seemed not to mind at all.

units.source_text: 不仅如此，有一次还以尊敬的口气，夸我这个人很大气。

en.t: More than that, on one occasion she even praised me in a respectful tone as a generous-hearted person.

units.source_text: 当时，实心眼的我有些脸红，赶忙对夫人的话加以否认。

en.t: At the time, being simple and honest, I blushed a little and hurriedly denied what Madam had said.

units.source_text: 于是，夫人认真地告诉我：‘你自己感觉不到，我才会这样说的。’

en.t: Then Madam told me earnestly, It is because you do not realize it yourself that I say so.

units.source_text: 其实，夫人原来并没打算找我这样的学生做房客，

en.t: In fact, Madam had not originally intended to take in a student like me as a lodger,

units.source_text: 而是想把那间客厅租给在官府做事的人，并拜托街坊给介绍的。

en.t: but had meant to rent that sitting room to someone working in a government office, and had asked the neighbors to introduce such a person.

units.source_text: 那些人是由于薪水低，才不得不寄居在非正式的借宿人家里的，

en.t: Such people, because their salaries were low, had no choice but to lodge in informal private homes,

units.source_text: 这个想法大概已经在夫人脑子里扎了根。

en.t: and that idea had probably already taken root in Madam's mind.

units.source_text: 她把心中想象的这种房客拿来和我一比较，便夸我大方了。

en.t: Comparing me with the sort of lodger she had imagined, she came to praise me as broad-minded.

units.source_text: 不错，同那些生活拮据的人相比，也许我在花钱方面算是大方的。

en.t: It is true that, compared with people living so frugally, I may have seemed generous with money.

units.source_text: 但是，这与性格无关，就如同与我的内心世界毫不相干一样。

en.t: But this had nothing to do with my character, just as it had nothing at all to do with my inner life.

units.source_text: 只能说，夫人是凭着女人的直觉，想以这个评价来概括我这个人罢了。

en.t: One can only say that Madam, relying on a woman's intuition, wanted to use that judgment to sum me up as a person.
